flaws.note: The whole parsed config, S3 secret, webhook signing secret and admin token included, is written to the log at startup. The redacted() helper exists and is not used here.

The tar step goes through a shell with the tenant name interpolated; the admin API accepts any 1 to 64 character tenant string, so a request body can run commands as the worker. Every other call uses the execFile helper.
rejectUnauthorized: false on the outbound agent; signed payloads with archive paths go to whoever can intercept the connection.
